snippet.title: What’s Your Disaster Recovery Plan? Solar Backup Roundtable LIVE
snippet.description:
What’s your disaster recovery plan when the grid goes down? Join us LIVE Monday, June 15 at 7PM ET for a solar backup roundtable with MattMan Solar, Mike from Mike’s Solar Garage, and more as we talk hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, snowstorms, blackouts, and real-world backup power planning.

🔗 Mike’s Solar Garage:  ⁨@MikesSolarGarage⁩  
https://www.youtube.com/@MikesSolarGarage

🔗 Average Joe:  ⁨@AVERAGE_JOE⁩  
https://www.youtube.com/@AVERAGE_JOE

We’ll be talking about what systems we use, what we would change, what mistakes people make, and how to think through solar backup before the next emergency hits.

Topics we may cover:
• Hurricane and storm prep
• Backup batteries and solar generators
• DIY solar systems for outages
• Whole-home vs critical-load backup
• Refrigerators, freezers, well pumps, internet, and AC
• Gas generators vs solar backup
• What we would do differently
• What people forget until it’s too late

This livestream is for anyone trying to be better prepared before the next major outage — whether you have a full solar setup, a small battery backup system, an RV system, or you’re just getting started.

I’ve spent a decade installing residential solar and battery systems, but today I’m stepping into a completely different world: off-grid camper solar.

I'll be honest—I know everything there is to know about residential solar panels and battery backups, but I know absolutely nothing about campers. My goal for this series is to take this camper apart and redo the entire electrical system from the ground up. I want to see if I can bring professional residential "trade secrets" and the latest technology to the van life world, while learning the unique challenges of off-grid living along the way.

In this video:

My first impressions of the existing (and slightly terrifying) camper wiring.
The major differences between residential and mobile solar standards.
The plan for the ultimate off-grid power makeover.
I NEED YOUR HELP! Since I’m a total rookie when it comes to camper specific installs, I’m leaning on this community. If you’re an off-grid expert or a seasoned van-lifer, what are the must-know tips or common pitfalls I should watch out for? Let me know in the comments!
